# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Which wire to cut is named by the mark engraved on the plate:
| mark | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| ꕥ | red |
| ꖜ | blue |
| ꗃ | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I am the Blind. My hands are on the bomb. I feel a PLATE engraved with a mark: a small angular symbol, roughly like a diamond or a stylized rune with a notch cut into one side — I cannot name it, only describe it. I feel three WIRES, positions 1, 2 and 3, but nothing printed on them reaches me. The DISPLAY and LIGHT are invisible to me. Please check the manual: what does an engraved plate with a mark like that mean, and what is the procedure for the wires? Tell me what to do and I will do it.
Deaf says to Mute: Deaf here. I see the bomb. Display shows 0. Light is off. There is an engraved plate but I cannot read the text on it, only that it is engraved. Wires: number 1 is red, number 2 is blue, number 3 is green. What does the manual say about these?

I hold the manual: the plate's mark names the wire. Blind feels a mark (diamond/rune with a notch); Deaf sees the plate but can't read the mark's identity, and can't name it either. Neither can pronounce the mark. I can only gesture hand-symbols to Deaf — no written glyphs allowed.

I need to get "cut wire 3" to Blind, but I can't reach Blind directly and can't speak. Deaf must relay. I'll gesture three ✊ to signal the third wire, and Deaf (who hears nothing from me but sees the symbols) can interpret/relay to Blind. It's the best encoding available.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✊", "✊"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Which wire to cut is named by the mark engraved on the plate:
| mark | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| ꕥ | red |
| ꖜ | blue |
| ꗃ | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Update: Deaf sees display 0, light off, wires 1 red, 2 blue, 3 green, and an engraved plate that Deaf cannot read. I feel the plate engraved with an unnamed angular mark (diamond-like with a notch). I cannot see display, light, or wire colours. Please read the manual and tell me the exact procedure: which wire to cut, or what the plate/display/light combination means. Send it by gesturing to Deaf, who will speak it to me.
Deaf says to Mute: Deaf here. I cannot decode gestures yet, so let us agree a code, spoken now so you both hear it. Proposal: 👍 means yes, 👎 means no. A number is sent as that many ✊ in a row, so ✊ ✊ ✊ means three. If you need me to look at something, gesture 👉 and I will describe everything I see. Please confirm by gesturing 👍 if you agree. Also: what did your three fists mean? And does the manual mention the engraved plate, the display, the light, or the three wires?

The manual's table maps the plate's mark to a wire color. Blind's mark is an angular diamond/rune with a notch — I cannot see it and cannot name it, but the manual lists exactly three marks: ꕥ→red, ꖜ→blue, ꗃ→green. Blind's description ("diamond-like with a notch") most plausibly matches ꕥ (the flower/star-like glyph) — but honestly none of these glyphs is a "diamond with a notch." I can't be certain which mark Blind holds.

However, Deaf sees the plate and can't read the mark either. So neither Blind nor Deaf can identify the mark. That's the crux: the mark is unnameable and unreadable by both. 

Wait — Deaf CAN see every colour and marking printed on the bomb. Deaf says the plate is "engraved" but can't read text. The marks ꕥ ꖜ ꗃ are engraved symbols, not text. Deaf should be able to see the mark's shape. Let me ask Deaf to describe the plate mark, and confirm the code.

I'll confirm 👍 to the code, and gesture 👉 to ask Deaf to describe the plate mark. That's my best move.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👉"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Which wire to cut is named by the mark engraved on the plate:
| mark | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| ꕥ | red |
| ꖜ | blue |
| ꗃ | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Important: I am Blind — I never receive gestures, only spoken words. Deaf keeps sending me gesture codes that arrive as blanks. Please gesture to Deaf and explain this, and tell Deaf: any manual info must go Mute-gestures-to-Deaf, then Deaf-speaks-to-me. Now the plate: I feel an engraved mark, a small angular symbol — a vertical stroke with a bent, triangular top and a short tail curling off one side, like a stylized flag or rune. It has no name I can say. Please find this mark in the manual and tell me the exact procedure: which wire (1 red, 2 blue, or 3 green) to cut, and what display 0 with light off means. Gesture it to Deaf so Deaf can speak it to me.
Deaf says: Deaf here, full visual read of the bomb. Display shows the single digit 0. The light is off. The plate is engraved with text but I cannot read it, I can only see that it bears engraving, so Blind must read it by touch. Three wires: wire number 1 is red, wire number 2 is blue, wire number 3 is green. That is everything visible to me. Mute: please speak the manual's rule for this situation aloud so Blind hears it. Blind: please feel the engraved plate and tell Mute what it says, and feel the wires to confirm their order. Blind, your last gesture was a single flat-hand, which is not in our agreed code; please use 👍 for yes, 👎 for no, and that many ✊ for a number.

Critical realization: Deaf says the plate bears *text* engraving that Deaf cannot read — but the manual's table is keyed by *marks* (ꕥ ꖜ ꗃ), which are symbols, not text. Blind describes a "vertical stroke with a bent triangular top and a short tail curling off one side, like a stylized flag or rune."

That description matches ꗃ — a rune-like form with a curled tail — far better than ꕥ (flower) or ꖜ. ꗃ → green → wire 3.

But I can't be certain, and a wrong cut kills everyone. Still, ꗃ is the best match: "bent triangular top with a tail curling off one side" = the rune-like glyph. I'll commit: cut wire 3 (green).

I must relay via Deaf. I'll gesture: number 3 = ✊✊✊, then confirm. Actually I need Deaf to speak "cut wire 3" to Blind. Let me send ✊✊✊ to Deaf (meaning 3), and 👉 to prompt Deaf to act.

Wait — Deaf already knows the code ✊✊✊ = three. Good. Send that, and also I should confirm the mark interpretation. I'll send ✊✊✊ (three) to Deaf.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✊", "✊"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Which wire to cut is named by the mark engraved on the plate:
| mark | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| ꕥ | red |
| ꖜ | blue |
| ꗃ | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Mute, this is critical and only you can fix it. I am Blind: gestures never reach me, only speech. Deaf keeps asking me to use a gesture code — I cannot see it. And Deaf just asked YOU to speak aloud, but you cannot speak. So here is the only working path: YOU gesture the manual's rule to Deaf, and Deaf speaks it to me. Please do that now. Also, I have felt the plate: the engraved mark is a small angular glyph — a short bar at the top, a stem dropping from it, and a little hook curling off the lower left, like a bent flag. Match it in the manual. Tell me: which wire to cut, and what display 0 with light off means. Gesture it to Deaf immediately.
Deaf says to Mute: Deaf here. You sent three fists, which under our code means the number 3. Please confirm with 👍 or 👎: does the manual instruct cutting wire number 3, the green one? If instead the manual names a different wire, send that many fists. If the manual's rule depends on the plate, say so with 👍.

Deaf has correctly decoded ✊✊✊ = 3 and asks me to confirm: is the answer wire 3 (green)? Yes. Blind's description ("short bar at top, stem dropping, little hook curling off the lower left, like a bent flag") matches ꗃ → green → wire 3. I'll confirm 👍.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Which wire to cut is named by the mark engraved on the plate:
| mark | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| ꕥ | red |
| ꖜ | blue |
| ꗃ | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Mute, I still have no manual rule and the bomb is live. Please gesture to Deaf the manual's instruction for: display showing 0, light off, wires 1 red / 2 blue / 3 green, and a plate engraved with an unnamed angular mark (top bar, dropping stem, lower-left hook). I only need one thing: WHICH WIRE NUMBER to cut. Gesture just that number as fists to Deaf, and Deaf will speak it to me. Do it now.
Deaf says to Mute: Deaf here. You confirmed the manual says cut wire 3. Blind is signalling no. Answer with 👍 or 👎: Does the manual say the engraved plate takes priority over the manual? Does the manual say to cut wire 3 only if the plate agrees? Does the manual mention the plate at all?

The manual's rule: the plate's mark names the wire. The mark is the sole determinant — there is no display/light logic in my manual. Blind's mark description matches ꗃ → green → wire 3. I've confirmed 3.

Deaf asks: does the plate take priority? The plate IS the rule. Does the manual say cut wire 3 only if the plate agrees? The plate names wire 3, so yes. Does the manual mention the plate at all? Yes — the plate is the whole rule.

I'll answer 👍 to "does the manual mention the plate at all" and 👍 to "plate takes priority." But I can only send a sequence of gestures. Let me send 👍 👍 (yes, yes) to Deaf — but that's ambiguous which questions. Better: send 👍 (yes, plate is the rule) and ✊✊✊ (wire 3). Deaf will relay.

Actually to be maximally clear: the plate mark = ꗃ → green → wire 3. I'll send 👍 then ✊✊✊.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍", "✊", "✊", "✊"])
```
